description: Verify a hash-pinned artifact ref against the active profile's declared artifact types. Returns manifest metadata (artifactType, slug, sha256, bytes, contentKind, writtenAt) plus a health verdict — NEVER the artifact body. Read-only; no write or store-wide list tool is exposed over MCP.

sha256.description: The 64-character lowercase-hex sha256 digest to verify against.
